h:
YAHUSHA ISN’T RETURNING FOR A WORSHIP NIGHT IN JERUSALEM.

He’s not descending in sandals to host interfaith dialogues.

He’s not passing out hugs at the Western Wall. He’s not showing up to play acoustic guitar at a revival tent.

He’s not leading a peace parade.

He’s coming to wage war.

Literal. Military. Global. Final.

This isn’t the second act of grace.
It’s the execution phase of the King’s judgment.

REVELATION 19: WAR MODE ENGAGED

“Then I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse! The One sitting on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and makes war.”
— Revelation 19:11

That phrase “makes war” in Greek?

Polemeō — this isn't spiritual symbolism. It's battlefield language.

Strategic invasion. Active hostility. Open conflict.

He doesn’t arrive with suggestions. He arrives with a battle plan. He doesn’t come to negotiate. He comes to end every rebellion with blood and fire.

SWORD FROM HIS MOUTH

“From His mouth comes a sharp sword
to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with a rod of iron.”

That sword isn't figurative.
It's not a metaphor for dialogue or debate.
It's the lethal Word backed by heavenly force.

When He strikes, nations fall.
When He rules, it's not with democracy, it’s with dominion.

He’s not coming to inspire political reform.
He’s coming to burn down Babylon and rewrite law with iron.

WINEPRESS OF WRATH

“He treads the winepress of the fury
of the wrath of God Almighty.”

This winepress isn’t symbolic art.
It’s divine wrath made visible.

And the grapes? They're people.

Unrepentant leaders. Globalists. Apostates. Idols. Systems that mock holiness and legalize abomination.

He stomps. And the stain left behind isn’t grape juice. It’s blood.

ISAIAH 63: BLOOD-SOAKED VENGEANCE

“I have trodden the winepress alone…
their blood spattered my garments.”

No angelic escort. No heavenly court.

Just the King. Waging war alone. Unflinching. Unrestrained.

This is not the blonde-haired, blue-eyed painting of church walls. This is not the whispery “turn-the-other-cheek” messiah of woke doctrine.

This is the High Priest draped in warfare, boots soaked, robe dripping, sword drawn.

He came once to absorb wrath.
Now He returns to unleash it.

PSALM 2: GLOBAL COUP D'ÉTAT

“Ask of Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance… You will break them with a rod of iron.”

He doesn’t campaign for office.
He doesn’t kiss babies or shake hands.

He comes to take the nations by decree.
No summit. No veto. No delay.

This is the end of pluralism, progressivism, humanism, and tolerance for evil.

He doesn’t coexist with darkness.
He conquers it.

This is military monarchy.

This is Torah supremacy.

This is the return of righteous rule.

WHEN HE RETURNS...

He’s not mounted on a donkey of peace.
He’s on a war horse of conquest.

He’s not bruised and bleeding.
He’s blazing with the fury of Heaven.

He’s not mocked by soldiers.
He commands them.

His robe is no longer soaked in His own blood. It’s dyed with the blood of kings, tyrants, and rebels.

He’s not requesting worship.
He’s enforcing allegiance.

THIS ISN’T THE JESUS BABYLON SOLD YOU

This isn’t soft-spoken televangelist Jesus.
This isn’t skinny-jeans youth group Jesus.
This isn’t the floating hologram of universal love.

This is the Commander of the Armies of YHWH. This is Heaven’s General.
This is the Lion of Judah with fire in His eyes.

And when He arrives?

No appeals court.

No religious exemptions.

No diplomatic immunity.

Just one global broadcast:

Every knee. Now. Or never.

Bow. Or break.

THEOLOGY CHECKPOINT

If your theology can’t stomach a King who executes justice with His own hands—Your theology is Roman propaganda.

If your Messiah always forgives but never judges—you’re worshiping a false Christ.

The Lamb came to be slain. The Lion comes to slay.

And when He roars?

The mountains melt.

The nations tremble.

The wicked scatter.

Too violent for you?
Too intense? Too judgmental?

You’ve been discipled by Babylon.

This isn’t extremism. This is what justice looks like after patience expires.

He gave the world millennia to repent.
He offered covenant. Cross. Forgiveness.
He sent prophets. Apostles. Dreams. Signs. Warnings.

But the final window of mercy closes with fire.

So choose your side before the skies split open. Because when He rides in?

There is no neutrality.

You are either: in His army or in His way.

Allegiance or annihilation.

Choose. Now.

The remnant isn’t looking for comfort. They’re craving clarity. Share this with one person too comfortable with compromise.
